title: ComfyUI (image generation)
description: An image connector for a ComfyUI server, running the workflow you paste in (or a basic SD1.5 graph). Gives agents a generate_image tool. It installs unapproved: review the node map and approve it in Admin > Extensions.
setup_notes: ComfyUI must be reachable from the gohort server (the default port is 8188). To use your own workflow, build it in ComfyUI with a SaveImage node, export it with Workflow > Export (API) (older versions: turn on Dev mode in Settings, then Save (API Format)) and paste that file's contents below. Leave it blank for a basic SD1.5 graph.

questions.name: base_url
questions.label: ComfyUI address
questions.help: The address gohort reaches ComfyUI at, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:8188

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Letters, digits and underscores; the tool is named after it.

questions.name: workflow
questions.label: Workflow (API format)
questions.help: The JSON from ComfyUI's Export (API). Blank uses a basic SD1.5 graph.
